name: Monument de l'Indépendance
subtitle: A ten-metre monument in Lomé commemorating independence on 27 April 1960, topped by a female bust that holds up the flame of freedom.

facts.label: Designers
facts.value: Georges Coustère, finished by Paul Ahyi
